stem.en: At Dwarka the sea rises and falls about twice a day, even on calm days. What is the best reason to think wind is not the cause?

text.en: The sea at Dwarka is deeper than the open sea

feedback.en: No. Depth does not tell us the cause, and this claim is not true.

text.en: It keeps to regular times in any weather

feedback.en: Yes. Wind changes with the weather, but this rise and fall keeps its times.

text.en: The water at Dwarka is saltier than other seas

feedback.en: No. Saltiness does not make the sea rise and fall twice a day.

text.en: The sea moves only along the temple pathway

feedback.en: No. The whole coast rises and falls, not just the pathway.

explanation.en: Waves made by wind grow in a storm and die away in calm weather. A rise and fall that keeps to regular times on calm days as well must have some other cause.

hints.en: Compare a windy day with a calm one.
